ds_tacz_compat.configuration.title: TACZ DS Compat Config
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.hideFirstPe: When enabled, dragon arms will not render in first-person while holding TACZ guns.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.hideThirdPe: If true, hide third-person guns on dragons entirely. If false, render the gun floating above the dragon.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunHeightOf: Default height offset of the floating gun, in blocks. This only sets the default value; configure per-model values in the Dragon Models tab.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunFloatSpe: Vertical bobbing speed of the floating gun, in full float cycles per second. Set 0 to stop. Higher = faster.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunBaseScal: Default scale of the floating gun. This only sets the default value; configure per-model values in the Dragon Models tab.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunScaleWit: Scale the floating gun with the dragon's size, matching DragonSurvival's third-person item behavior.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunOffsetSc: Scale the floating gun's positional offsets (left/right, forward/back, height) with the dragon's size.
Default left/right offset of the floating gun, in blocks. This only sets the default value; configure per-model values in the Dragon Models tab.
Default forward/back offset of the floating gun, in blocks. This only sets the default value; configure per-model values in the Dragon Models tab.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.aimSmoothin: EMA smoothing time for the gun aim-follow animation, in seconds. Set 0 to instant.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunPitchCla: Maximum downward pitch in degrees below horizontal. Prevents the gun aiming at dragon body.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.tracerVisib: Show bullet tracers for dragon players.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.hideRemoteT: Hide bullet tracers from other dragon players, matching original TACZ behavior.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.forceShowCr: Force the TACZ crosshair to show in third person.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.adsFeatureE: While a dragon aims in third person, show the TACZ crosshair and fade the dragon model so the head doesn't block it.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.adsFadeAmou: How much the dragon model fades while aiming in third person. 0 = opaque, 1 = fully transparent.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.glidingShoo: Allow dragons to shoot while gliding. When disabled, aiming or reloading exits flight.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.speedInflue: Multiplier for TACZ's movement-speed influence on dragons. Defaults to 1; set to 0 to disable the TACZ speed penalty.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.syncBackGun: Sync dragon players' back-gun item to nearby clients so remote dragons show it.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.syncRemoteG: Show muzzle flash and shell ejection for remote dragon players.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.recoilCance: Master switch for the no-recoil feature for dragon players.
Controls the active scope of no-recoil for dragon players. The three options are: active while gliding, active while flying, always active. WARNING: the latter two may break game fairness.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.backGunEnab: Render hotbar guns on the dragon's back, anchored to the torso bone.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.backGunScal: Uniform scale of the back gun.
ds_tacz_compat.config.dragon_models.no_w: Enter a world to configure per-dragon-model options.
ds_tacz_compat.cloth_config_warning:
Cloth Config API is not installed, so the mod config screen cannot be opened.
Please install Cloth Config and try again.
ds_tacz_compat.config.model_tool.apply: Apply Global Defaults to Dragon Models
ds_tacz_compat.config.model_tool.apply_w: This will overwrite every dragon model's floating gun and back gun offsets and scale with the current global defaults. Continue?
